A = data('spans.count', filter=f and filter('httpMethod', '*'), rollup='delta', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['service', 'operation', 'httpMethod']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('spans.count', filter=f and filter('httpMethod', '*'), rollup='delta', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['service', 'operation', 'httpMethod']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*(B-A)/B).publish(label='C')
D = data('spans.count', filter=f and (not filter('httpMethod', '*')), rollup='delta', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['service', 'operation']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
E = data('spans.count', filter=f and (not filter('httpMethod', '*')), rollup='delta', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['service', 'operation']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
F = (100*(E-D)/E).publish(label='F')

chart.programText:
A = data('cpu.utilization', filter=filter('sf_environment', '*') and filter('sf_service', '*')).publish(label='A')
B = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('sf_environment', '*') and filter('sf_service', '*') and (not filter('state', 'idle'))).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('sf_environment', '*') and filter('sf_service', '*')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = ((B/C)*100).publish(label='D')

Metrics only populate these charts if your service is running in Kubernetes and you have configured the OpenTelemetry Collector to monitor your Kubernetes environment.
